name: vlm_actin_stress_fiber_prominence
description: Visually evaluates the prominence and organization of actin stress fibers. The loss of stress fibers or formation of cortical actin rings are specific responses to actin-modulating drugs, captured well by visual description.
segmentation_prompt: Segment individual cells using the Actin channel.
method_rationale: Evaluating the 'prominence' or 'organization' of fibers is a subjective visual task that VLMs can perform consistently.
